text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Daring Tact has a sharper gaze than 
usual. 
She gives off an unapproachable aura, 
almost frighteningly so.
choice_data_list: Daring Tact... are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I am fine. There is nothing at all 
for you to worry about."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I am deeply focused, in a wonderful 
state. 
...Just like spending a night deep in the 
mountains."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, not even the fiercest wild 
beast 
could ever outmatch me...!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze sends a shiver down my spine. 
No one could hope to rival Daring Tact 
today.
